The issuer shows weak credit metrics: liquidity is below 1.0x (current ratio 0.83), leverage is very high (liabilities are about 93% of assets, with equity only about 7% of assets), and operating income is small relative to the asset base. Positive retained earnings and positive EBIT support some ongoing resilience, but the balance-sheet risk appears more consistent with speculative-grade credit.

DECISION: BB-
